blocks.content: Quiz: Why do we use a query key factory instead of writing keys directly in each component?
Tap an option below to answer:
Because React Query requires it for mutations to work
React Query doesn't require a factory. It's a pattern you choose to adopt.
React Query doesn't require a factory. It's a pattern you choose to adopt.
Because it keeps all keys in one place so typos and mismatches can't silently break your cache
Correct. One source of truth means if a key changes you fix it once and everything stays in sync.
Correct. One source of truth means if a key changes you fix it once and everything stays in sync.
Because query keys only work when they're imported from a separate file
Keys work fine written inline. The factory is about maintainability not functionality.
Keys work fine written inline. The factory is about maintainability not functionality.
Because the factory automatically invalidates queries when data changes
The factory just generates keys. Invalidation is still your job.
The factory just generates keys. Invalidation is still your job.
